scenarios.title: Verify unified diff lines count display before patch
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the unified diff lines count includes all lines without subtracting one, showing pre-patch line count.

scenarios.title: Verify 'Index repository context' button enablement requires valid PR URL and apiReady true
scenarios.purpose: Check that the 'Index repository context' button is disabled if no PR URL or apiReady is not true before patch.

scenarios.title: Verify header pill text and connection pill status before patch
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the header pill and connection pill show 'Setup required' and 'disconnected' when API is not ready before patch.

scenarios.title: Verify 'Analyze change' button default disabled state before patch
scenarios.purpose: Check that the 'Analyze change' button is disabled when pullRequestUrl is empty and API is not ready, before patch.

scenarios.title: Verify no actionable findings message before any review
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the review findings panel shows the empty state message when no review has been done.
